notes.title: Update About Development
notes.notes:
Just news, no new playable build yet.

Instead of continuing to patch the holes in the old version I decided that it would be easier to restart. I delayed any announcement as I wanted to be close to having something playable first.

NEW VERSION
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33682829/ed67a4a7f48ca51c8055498408ba8fd0b5b2c016.png[/img]


ROLL ATTACK
When designing the new version of this game I wanted to give the player more movement options. That way the standard gameplay could be more interesting and fun without the need for any powerups.

With the roll attack you can build up speed by rolling downhill or through enemies/breakable blocks.
So long as you have enough speed you will keep rolling. It can also be used as an attack while swimming. This should make water levels faster paced than before.

As a result of this I've removed the magic wand and punch attack since they didn't fit with the new gameplay.


MENUS
You can customize the game's settings and controls during gameplay instead of just on the title screen. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33682829/4267e395cde325844641af67a3e5de8af44535e8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33682829/f3da44be97d48e44673a871b76d3d4a80c6265e2.png[/img]

In the Extras menu you can view your awards, a summary of levels cleared/things collected, upgrades and player skins. The game will still have Steam achievements but each save file will have it's own in-game achievements to match them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33682829/ab8dc7ff1777524d4b9a792884b96e679ddb049f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33682829/167a58d251f57e04c869e925b5a6cf776e5154bc.png[/img]
The ? coins are used to unlock new upgrades and the CDs are used for unlocking optional challenge levels

Your playtime and completion % can be viewed on the file screen

ITEMS
Aside from transformations and level gimmicks there are now two main powerups. The Green Heart and the Fairy. These are found in normal levels. Usually in secret areas.

The Green Heart allows you to take an extra hit and refills your heart meter.

The Fairy will now save you whenever you would have lost a life. Such as falling down a pit or crashing your mine cart. It will also revive you if you run out of hearts and allow you to continue playing without having to restart the level.

The armour item was replaced by pink hearts that refill your heart meter. The main reason for this change was to make it easier to add in new player skins. Basically I won't have to draw armoured and unarmoured versions of everything.
At this point the only skins available are different coloured versions of the normal player sprite but more will be added later. Probably as an update after release.

At the item shop you no longer buy powerups. Instead you can buy new player skins and a few permanent upgrades such as increasing your heart meter.

The game will still have optional mini games where you can earn extra lives.



More to come this month.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
More Achievements will be added later in development.



Updates:

Zone 2 music updated

Changed level names to 1-1, 1-2 etc.

Updated graphics, music and design of 3-2

Spider enemies will now get stuck in honey

Improved collision detection for timed golden blocks

Camera improvements to 3-2, 1-5, 2-1

Added level 3-3

Update behavior of hand item to make it work on 3-3

Added balloon platforms

Added invisible blocks

Updated map screen menu

Added Steam Achievements



Bug fixes:

Inventory item box showing behind the pause screen background

Removed the Mystery Medal gate blocking 1-5 since It was bugged and didn't remove any Mystery Medals from the player.

Path to Wally's Fishing Hole not opening

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Updates:

New graphics for level 1 of Zone 3

Replaced flower objects in level 1 of Zone 3 with horizontal vines to climb on

Redesigned level 1 of Zone 3 to make use of new vines

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Updates:

Vines that can be climbed on

5 new enemies

Added the first 2 levels of Zone 3

Zone maps linked together by a new main map

Map camera can now scroll

Player's map sprite can now face four directions

Changed Witch design and made cutscene shorter

Changed sound effect for defeating enemies

Disabled wall jumping/sliding when close to water

Findy Ghost will hover over doors and warp points if they lead to Mystery Medals

Changed spike graphics

Improved controls on bird level

Camera improvements in Mazy Marsh 2

Made cloud platforms easier to see

Improved collision detection for jumping on enemies



Bug fixes:

Bell timer not playing sound effects at correct pitch

Player could take damage from enemies during screen transition after exiting level from menu

Player could get stuck if they opened a door while they were wall sliding

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Updates:

-Hammer hitbox and animation improved

-Hammer no longer damages the bird boss

-Spiked ball and chain graphics changed

-Magic wand turns enemies into gems

-Increased speed of Magic wand fireball

-New level added to Mazy Marsh

-Minor graphical changes to some enemies and effect animations

-Added sign posts to map screen to show which zone you are in


Bug fixes:

-Couldn't hit ceiling crabs if hammer hitbox overlapped the background

-Enemy sprites sometimes remained on screen after they had been defeated

-Enemy sprites would sometimes flicker after being defeated

notes.title: Update v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Just a small update mainly to fix a bug some people were having when trying to play with a controller. 
The next update will have some new content.


Updates:

-Minor graphical changes to menu fonts

-Improved detection when jumping on enemies in mine cart



Bug fixes:

-Controllers sometimes not working

-Collected items could overlap the pause screen

-Player could equip more than 2 wands or hammers from the map screen inventory

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
This update adds the first of the transformation levels to the game.


Updates:

-Bell ticking sound effect now increases in pitch as it counts down

-Player now loses equipped items after getting a game over

-Castle intro doesn't play again unless player exits the level

-Invisible gems blocks now play a sound effect when triggered

-Added mystery medal gate to world 1 map

-Added bird transformation level




Bug fixes:

-Crab sometimes not going into shell after shot with magic wand

-Player would sometimes jump after going through a door

-Sign post text could overlap the pause screen

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
